title: Figures 27-28: Boost-glide strategic vehicle model and XLR-129 rocket engine on test stand
description: Two black-and-white photographs. Left: a dark model of a boost-glide hypersonic vehicle with an engine nozzle mounted on a stand; caption: "Figure 27. Boost-Glide Strategic Vehicle With Pratt & Whitney XLR-129 Rocket Engine Installed, Circa 1964." Right: a large rocket engine with surrounding plumbing on a test stand; caption: "Figure 28. XLR-129, a Shuttle-Class Engine That Ran for 40 Test Cycles With Only Component Maintenance and No Engine Rebuilding."
